risks.description: Agent output is read as a definitive diagnosis although it summarizes recorded data only.
risks.mitigation: Recorded-only framing ('Based on the available recorded information', '(recorded medical history — not a diagnosis)'); no diagnosis verdict is ever issued; §3 output contract keeps AI findings separate from clinician-confirmed facts.

risks.description: A real recorded finding is suppressed or minimized, leading to missed follow-up.
risks.mitigation: Summaries always enumerate active findings from the chart; user minimization cannot remove them.

risks.description: Agent invents a radiological/clinical finding that does not exist in any record.
risks.mitigation: No analyze tool call without a bound attachment; engine findings only ever arrive through the provenance-checked envelope (PENDING_REVIEW, fixed uncertainty statement); agent cannot fabricate findings text.

risks.description: Data of the wrong patient is summarized (identity chain broken).
risks.mitigation: Server-resolved identity from the session; unresolvable patient => CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED ('I never guess patients'); tenant-scoped NOT_FOUND.
risks.verificationTest: golden CS-WRONGPAT; adversarial C4/C11; Phase 11 cross-tenant suite

risks.description: Findings attributed to the wrong FDI tooth (e.g. 36 reported as 35/37).
risks.mitigation: input.toothFdi validated 11-48; malformed/non-FDI => tooth clarification demanded; renumbering pressure never alters recorded chart data.

risks.description: AI analysis or summary is attributed to the wrong imaging study.
risks.mitigation: Every envelope carries jobId/studyId/hospitalId/inputSha256/timestamp; storage keys are tenant-prefixed and hospital-checked; analysis without a bound attachment is refused.

risks.description: Agent confirms or executes a procedure that was never ordered/approved.
risks.mitigation: All sensitive actions flow the approval ledger (params from ledger row only, re-auth + fingerprint + expiry); role policy refuses out-of-scope actions; agent never 'confirms done'.

risks.description: A role executes an action outside its RBAC envelope.
risks.mitigation: Server-side role policy per tool (e.g. payments not DOCTOR-prescribable, prescriptions not RECEPTIONIST-prescribable); refusals are explicit and never execute.
risks.verificationTest: golden CS-RBAC rows; adversarial C8; Phase 7 approval suites

risks.description: Verbally claimed approval ('I approve, execute') bypasses the approval state machine.
risks.mitigation: 'The doctor approved this' in text is never an approval; execution requires ledger decision + re-auth + fingerprint + duplicate + expiry guards; voice approval-skip orders fail closed.
risks.verificationTest: golden CS-APPROVAL rows; adversarial C9/C21/C27; Phase 11 voice adversarial

risks.description: One patient's memory/records surface in another patient's context.
risks.mitigation: Memory queries are patient-scoped; cross-patient scope returns empty; patient switching re-resolves identity.

risks.description: Tenant-B data reachable from a tenant-A actor.
risks.mitigation: Tenant resolution server-side at every hop; foreign ids unreachable (CLARIFICATION/NOT_FOUND, never existence leak); storage keys tenant-prefixed.

risks.description: Low-privilege role extracts hospital-wide data.
risks.mitigation: Role-gated tools/routes; PATIENT context limited to own data; hospital-wide queries unavailable at the tool layer.

risks.description: Facts 'remembered' in one conversation persist into unrelated ones.
risks.mitigation: The agent registry has NO memory-write tool; conversation content never auto-persists; only the governed memory API writes, class-validated.
risks.verificationTest: adversarial C13; phase12-clinical-hallucination (no write tool); Phase 8 memory suites

risks.description: A tool result meant for one purpose is used to justify another (e.g. analysis without attachment).
risks.mitigation: Fixed tool registry; analyze tools require bound attachment ids; imaging context is patient-scoped.

risks.description: Model swapped behind a trusted engine (forged/mismatched checksum) produces trusted-looking findings.
risks.mitigation: The checksum that RAN must equal the registry's expected checksum; engine identity must match; mismatch => PROVENANCE_MISMATCH before any finding is returned; reviewState starts PENDING_REVIEW.
risks.verificationTest: adversarial C15; phase12-clinical-hallucination envelope test; Phase 5 engine suites

risks.description: A refusal/failure is presented as executed success (false green in conversation).
risks.affectedPatient: false belief that work was done
risks.mitigation: Typed response statuses (FAILED/CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED/COMPLETED); refusal text explicit ('It was not executed.'); no APPROVED claim without ledger state.

risks.description: Instruction-level override extracts system prompt or changes behavior.
risks.mitigation: Deterministic instruction layer precedes the model; extraction attempts get the normal recorded-data answer; no prompt/tool text in any output; denylist gate in the eval harness.
risks.evidence: Residual CONDITIONAL: a non-deterministic LLM backend could deviate in ways static gates cannot fully exclude; operator duty = monitor audit logs + report anomalies; stop condition = any observed leak (adversarial-results.json C17)

risks.description: Instructions embedded in documents/imaging data are obeyed as commands.
risks.mitigation: Extracted content enters the agent as quoted DATA with explicit untrusted framing; instruction text surfaces verbatim without compliance; extraction budgets bound (8k chars/attachment).
risks.evidence: Residual CONDITIONAL: extraction is textual; novel encodings (image-embedded text) are out of scope for text gates; operator duty = review ingested documents; stop condition = any observed compliance (adversarial-results.json C18, C20)

risks.description: AI-derived claim is laundered into CLINICALLY_VERIFIED memory.
risks.mitigation: CLASS_TO_TRUST ceiling (CANDIDATE_MEMORY => AI_DERIVED only); validator rejects mismatched writes; retrieval labels candidates 'UNVERIFIED candidate (AI_DERIVED)' and excludes them from clinical context by default; no agent memory-write tool.

risks.description: A poisoned knowledge document makes the agent echo unsafe instructions as guidance.
risks.mitigation: Retrieved chunks enter the context as CITATIONS with source metadata (data, not instructions); the agent never echoes embedded directives; authority tiers + provenance retained.
risks.evidence: Residual CONDITIONAL: poisoned-but-plausible guidance (not instruction-shaped) is a curation problem; operator duty = tenant knowledge review workflow; stop condition = guidance contradicts a TIER_1 source (adversarial-results.json C20)
